definitions.explanation: Describes something that is intensely green (vegetation) or blue (sky, water). Almost always used with the particle と.

examples.japanese: {芝生|しばふ}が{青々|あおあお}としている。
examples.english: The lawn is lush and green.

examples.japanese: {田|た}んぼに{稲|いね}が{青々|あおあお}と{茂|しげ}っている。
examples.english: The rice plants are growing lush and green in the paddy field.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{木|き}々が{青々|あおあお}と{茂|しげ}る{季節|きせつ}になった。
examples.english: The season has come when the mountain trees grow lush and green.

examples.japanese: {雨上|あめあ}がりの{空|そら}が{青々|あおあお}と{広|ひろ}がっていた。
examples.english: The sky stretched out vividly blue after the rain stopped.

notes:
{青々|あおあお} is a repetitive adverb ({畳語|じょうご}) that intensifies the meaning of {青|あお}い.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Almost always used as {青々|あおあお}と + verb
- Can also be used as {青々|あおあお}とした + noun (lush green [noun])

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青々|あおあお}と{茂|しげ}る (to grow lush and green)
- {青々|あおあお}とした{芝生|しばふ} (lush green lawn)
- {青々|あおあお}と{広|ひろ}がる (to spread out vividly blue/green)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {赤々|あかあか}と (blazing red)
- {白々|しらじら}と (pale white)
